name: repository-harness
description: Harness validation manifest for the selected shell installation slice. It contains only stack-relevant add-ons plus shared structural checks.

filePresence.description: Every path in parameters.paths MUST exist as a regular file under the target repository root.

directoryPresence.description: Every path in parameters.paths MUST exist as a directory under the target repository root.

emptyDirectoryPlaceholders.description: Each directory in parameters.directories MUST contain at least one real file or a .gitkeep placeholder.

messages.default: empty directory must keep placeholder or real files: {directory}

scaffoldLeaks.description: Scan every file under parameters.scope.bases (excluding excludedSubtrees and files whose extension is not in extensions) and emit a finding for every regex match in parameters.patterns.

hookShebang.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST start with the line in parameters.expectedShebang.

hookExecutable.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST have its executable bit set on disk.

hookCommand.description: parameters.prePushHook MUST declare and run a command listed in parameters.allowedCommands. When parameters.allowedPreCommitCommands is non-empty, parameters.preCommitHook MUST also declare and run one of those commands; otherwise pre-commit MUST NOT run any full-stack validation command.

messages.commandNotRun: {hook} must run the declared validation command
messages.preCommitMustNotRunFullStack: pre-commit hook must not run full stack validation commands

ciHookCommandParity.description: Each existing file in parameters.ciFiles MUST contain the validation command declared by parameters.referenceHook. Absent files are skipped.

uncheckedTasks.description: Every file matching parameters.filenamePattern under parameters.directory MUST NOT contain any line matching parameters.uncheckedTaskPattern. Enforces that plans moved into directory have all tasks marked done.

symlinkSafety.description: Scanned shell harness roots MUST NOT be symbolic links, except the root contract AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md alias pair.

messages.scanRootNotAllowed: symlink scan root is not allowed: {path}
messages.scanEntryNotAllowed: symlink scan entry is not allowed: {path}

shellcheck.description: Every shell script file under the current directory (excluding .git) MUST pass shellcheck validation with no violations.

seedFiles.description: Optional placeholder files the harness installs but the target repository MAY replace, rename, or remove. Not a check.

generatedArtifacts.description: Policy for docs/generated/. Not a check.
generatedArtifacts.policy: Place actual generated repository artifacts here. Do not add fake placeholder files; keep the directory empty with .gitkeep until a real generation step exists.

harnessEvolution.description: Policy for how the harness evolves. Not a check. The harness is not versioned — the current committed state is the only authoritative shape.
harnessEvolution.policy: The in-repository harness may evolve across discovery, implementation, hardening, release, and maintenance. The current committed harness is the active contract; no schemaVersion, no retired keys, no alternate compatibility paths.

teamPatterns.description: Catalog of team/agent collaboration patterns this harness recognises. Not a check.
